about.title: Millbrae Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Millbrae's roughly 22,795 residents share a compact grid with heavy through-traffic, and San Mateo County's crash data shows it: 71 injury collisions and 98 people hurt in the most recent final year, with Thursday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. drawing the most reports. Corridors like El Camino Real, US-101, E Millbrae Avenue, and SR-82 see steady volume from commuters, SFO-bound travelers, and local errands overlapping at once. After a collision on any of these roads, the hours right after matter — photos of the scene, contact info from witnesses, and a visit to a doctor can all support a future claim. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect injured people in Millbrae with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain the options, free of charge and with no obligation to move forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: You generally have two years to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but claims involving a government road or vehicle can require notice in as little as six months. An attorney can flag which deadline applies to your Millbrae crash before it passes.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work in Your Favor
items.desc: California lets you recover damages even if you're partly at fault, with your share simply reducing the award. An attorney can push back on an insurer trying to inflate your percentage of blame after a crash on a busy corridor like El Camino Real.

items.title: No Cap Means Your Full Story Matters
items.desc: California doesn't cap non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases, so documenting how the injury affected daily life is worth doing carefully. Skipping a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer helps protect that story before it's on the record.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's usually best to avoid it, or at least talk to an attorney first. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can communicate on your behalf so you're not navigating that alone.

items.question: What if my accident happened near SFO or on US-101 through Millbrae?
items.answer: Crashes on state highways like US-101 can sometimes involve additional agencies or jurisdictional questions. An attorney familiar with San Mateo County roads can help sort out who's responsible and what evidence to gather quickly.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and the independent attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward after speaking with someone.
